visual_identity.core_identity: A viscous amoeboid dungeon ooze known for splitting into separate living masses when struck.
visual_identity.silhouette: Two irregular low jelly masses with rounded lobes and stringy connective drips, both clearly moving.
visual_identity.body_shape: Soft amorphous blobs with uneven edges, sagging folds, and no fixed limbs.
visual_identity.surface: Mostly open interiors with a few contour ripples and drip lines.

scene_identity.natural_posture: Both halves remain fully supported on floor or contacted surfaces.

known_failure_modes.correction: show two clearly separate but visually related jelly masses

known_failure_modes.symptom: one half gains eyes or mouth
